rationale: Repair PublishedEvidenceResolver so planner semantic subject references are not incorrectly treated as governed product identities. Exact resolved candidate substitutions remain preferred; otherwise one unique already-governed candidate identity may supply the instance boundary while the planner semantic subject and goal remain available for topic-neutral authoritative-publication lookup. Zero or multiple candidate identities remain fail-closed.
supersession_impact: No capability or historical artifact is superseded. The repair preserves the existing PublishedEvidenceResolver contract and authoritative-publication path while correcting its semantic-subject versus instance-identity handling.
authority_impact: No authority is broadened. USER_ANSWER still requires authoritative publication, Instance Sufficiency remains upstream, unresolved or ambiguous identity still fails closed, and the resolver cannot manufacture product identity or publication eligibility.
